title: Analysis of the Genotype/Phenotype Relationship in the Fuchs' Corneal Endothelial Dystrophy in France
official: Analysis of the Genotype/Phenotype Relationship in the Fuchs' Corneal Endothelial Dystrophy in France. The French Fuchs' Follow-up Study (Phase 2), F3S2
summary: The pathophysiology of the most common corneal endothelial dystrophies (Fuchs' Corneal Endothelial Dystrophy, FECD) is beginning to be dismembered. There is a significant heterogeneity in the clinical forms and the investigators have just highlighted a great diversity of histological forms that seem to define distinct groups.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* affiliated with or entitled to a social security scheme
* Consent form to participate in the study signed
* with an FECD certified by slit lamp examination
* requiring an endothelial keratoplasty

Exclusion Criteria:

\- Patients under guardianship or curators
sponsor: Centre Hospitalier Universitaire de Saint Etienne
